digest.component_or_area: Completion verifier evidence banking and verdict assembly
propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE incorrectly banks met=false (absence-of-evidence) indistinguishably from positive refutation (evidence-of-absence), causing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was not found within the search window

The banking write path and all verdict consumers must distinguish three evidence states (met, refuted, insufficient) where insufficient-evidence paths carry an optional evidence_sufficient:false framework-set marker alongside met=false, never a model-tool input, to preserve backward compatibility with fail-closed consumers

Banked insufficient entries must retain their evidence_sufficient:false marker through re-harvest overwrites (preserve-on-overwrite semantics), while genuine refutation (bare met=false from the model) replaces the marker, keeping the completion tool bool-only

Both verdict rendering seams and their exhausted placeholder branches must emit met=false + evidence_sufficient:false for insufficient entries with insufficient-evidence findings text, and merge_finalizer_with_bank must re-stamp from the bank over model echoes to serve as the authoritative marker source

The close gate must continue blocking on insufficient evidence (verdict stays FAIL) but report it as remediation-guided exhaustion (re-verify with discoverable evidence) rather than unmet criteria, explicitly discouraging operator-attested tag misuse on code-verifiable criteria
The sidecar FAIL payload must include criteria[] and top-level evidence_sufficient markers to durably record insufficiency as a verifier-capacity outcome distinct from substantive refutation
